snippet.title: [Maid Cafe Simulator] 2nd PV Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome, Manager! 🎀

Take orders, cook, and serve — this isn't your average point-and-click management game. Real cafe life starts here! ☕✨

Work through the busy shifts alongside five charming maids, and when the café closes, take a moment to listen to the warm stories they keep to themselves. 🐾💫

Think every day will be peaceful? Difficult customers, precious maids to protect — it's all on you. 🌙⚡

A story unfolding with maids full of charm and personality.
